statement: SDL recognizes simple Bluetooth report 0x01 and enhanced Bluetooth report 0x31; its enhanced-mode path sends effects to request the change. Linux hid-playstation accepts the full 78-byte Bluetooth input 0x31, not simple 0x01, and parses the common 63-byte input body after the two-byte Bluetooth prefix. This is a consumer compatibility requirement, not a measured retail transition.
